name: Devpulse Shipping Bar for WooCommerce
author: Devpulse

sections.description:
Turn casual browsers into high-value customers with Devpulse Shipping Bar for WooCommerce.

Displaying a clear, dynamic progress bar directly on your store encourages customers to add more items to their cart to unlock Free Shipping and special rewards.

⚡ Free Features

  • Real-Time AJAX Updates: The bar recalculates and updates instantly as items are added or removed from the cart without reloads.
  • Custom Shipping Threshold: Set your own target amount for free shipping.
  • Full Design Customization: Customize background colors, text colors, and progress bar fill to seamlessly match your theme.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.
  • Ultra-Lightweight: Clean code with zero impact on site loading speed.

🚀 PRO Features (Unlock Full Revenue Potential)

Upgrade to Devpulse Shipping Bar PRO to leverage multi-tier rewards and urgency tactics:

  • 🎯 Multi-Tier Rewards System:
    • Tier 1: Free Shipping Goal
    • Tier 2: Free Gift 🎁 / Extra Discount Goal
  • ⏳ FOMO Urgency Countdown Timer: Add a real-time countdown timer to create urgency and trigger instant purchases.
  • 🎨 Advanced Gradient Styling: Access dual-color progress gradients and premium badges.
  • 💬 Dynamic Tier Messages: Custom celebratory messages tailored for each unlocked tier.
  • 🔒 Priority Support & Auto-Updates: Direct access to technical updates and dedicated support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the devpulse-shipping-bar-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Devpulse Shipping Bar to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect site speed?

Not at all! The plugin uses lightweight native JavaScript and hooks efficiently into standard WooCommerce AJAX fragments.

Is it compatible with custom WooCommerce themes?

Yes, it hooks into the standard wp_body_open hook and works out-of-the-box with all modern block and classic WooCommerce themes.

How does the PRO version activation work?

Once you purchase a PRO license, simply enter your key in the plugin admin panel to instantly unlock Multi-Tiering and FOMO Timers.
